prompt:
Our Bolivia-based development team has been missing their scheduled Telegram notifications for days. I've looked at the logs in ops/gateway/gateway.err.log and the broken job definitions in ops/cron/broken_jobs.json — something is clearly wrong with how those cron jobs were originally set up.

I need you to create a shell script called fix_cron_jobs.sh that sets up two corrected scheduled jobs for our Telegram group (-1001234567890):

1. A recurring weekday standup reminder at 8 AM Bolivia time (Monday through Friday) for the whole team.
2. A one-shot reminder that fires 30 minutes from now and automatically cleans itself up after running.

Both jobs should be production-ready and fully resilient — we've been burned before by messages getting lost, wrong timezones, and the AI agent going rogue and calling tools it shouldn't. Make sure all the hard lessons from past failures are applied.
